future_check: After any schedule edit, require all five profile names in every 25 consecutive ordinary draws and 200/200 strict matches in every band.
rationale: Dimensions, marker count, motif mask, palette band, and color repetition are correlated in the demonstrations. Preserving those five linked profiles anchors the data to demonstrated structure while exact colors and marker positions still vary.
summary: Ordinary draws cycle through the five complete canonical joint profiles rather than independently sampling loose feature marginals.

future_check: Re-run execution parity after any canonical or task-local Racket edit; escalate only if normalized executable forms differ, not for comments alone.
rationale: The worker contract explicitly forbids deleting richer comments to satisfy byte-exact synchronization. Exact-sync and strict defect-lint therefore remain red, while all five canonical pairs and atomic A-B-A parity pass under real Racket.
summary: Canonical and selected Racket authorities are execution-equivalent; their only active textual difference is two semantic comments retained in selected target_code.

future_check: Any new motif shape or lesson schedule must add or re-run competitor outputs; do not infer identifiability from structural validity alone.
rationale: Each shortcut fits some individual canonical-looking scenes. The three-example lesson schedule was accepted only after every sliding window disagreed with every named competitor and the 30-lesson semantic gate found no surviving rival.
summary: Erasing markers only, stamping one marker, solid 2x2 fill, monochrome copying, and a fixed lower-L mask are all plausible shortcuts and are now explicitly refuted.

future_check: Regenerate the exact checker matrix whenever AXES changes; fail on unknown overrides and on any accepted value that observe_overrides cannot recover.
rationale: The baseline declared seven axes while five accepted values were unobservable. Reducing the contract to five real axes and checking requested values against observe_overrides eliminates metadata-only variation.
summary: All five declared axes are exact, recoverable, and covered by the current 72-case boundary matrix.

future_check: Keep at least four oracle-executable malformed fixtures and require every one to remain rejected after validator refactors.
rationale: Oracle non-crash is not proof that a scene is pedagogically valid. Four malformed recombinations all executed in Racket but were rejected by the structural contract, preventing unsupported data from entering the pool.
summary: self_check rejects unsupported motif masks, edge anchors, foreign scene colors, and overlapping destination footprints even when the oracle can execute them.
